message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: ['master']
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        rust:
          - stable
        features:
          - --all-features
          - --no-default-features

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.rust }}

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - run: cargo build -p hecs --all-targets ${{ matrix.features }}

      - run: cargo test -p hecs ${{ matrix.features }}

  no-std-build-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: x86_64-unknown-none

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      # Build the `test-no-std-macros` target with x86_64-unknown-none target
      - run: cargo build -p test-no-std-macros --target x86_64-unknown-none

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - run: cargo fmt --all -- --check

      - name: doc
        run: cargo doc --no-deps --all-features
        env:
          RUSTDOCFLAGS: -Dwarnings

      - run: cargo clippy --all-features -- -D warnings

  miri:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      # We only use permissive provenance ops for creating aligned
      # dangling pointers, and strict provenance is a big MSRV bump.
      MIRIFLAGS: -Zmiri-permissive-provenance
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@nightly
        with:
          components: miri, rust-src

      - name: Cache cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - run: cargo miri setup

        # miri doesn't want to run doctests for some reason
      - run: cargo miri test --all-features --lib --tests",
  "rationale": "The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (cache dependency downloads) applies to this Rust workflow: every job (test, no-std-build-test, lint, miri) repeatedly fetches crates from crates.io with no existing dependency cache, so repeated dependency fetching is measurable and cache inputs can be keyed on Cargo.lock plus runner OS. The pattern's preconditions are met and there are no contraindications (no mutable/untrusted cached content, no equivalent cache already present). I added actions/cache@v4 for ~/.cargo/registry and ~/.cargo/git before the cargo commands in each job, keyed by hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') with a restore-key prefix for partial matches. This avoids re-downloading dependencies on warm runs while preserving all build and test coverage: no steps, features, targets, toolchains, or required checks are removed or changed. It uses only the standard GitHub Actions cache service, adds no secrets, privileged actions, publishing/deployment, or new network access beyond cache storage/retrieval.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
